messages:
marie: Heads-up: embeddings-eu is seeing intermittent 502s for seq length > 1024 since 09:12 UTC. Impacting a few prod customers. Can we fast-track a hotfix push in the next 15m?
ben: on it — triage in progress. Can we avoid full canary? short window (09:30-09:45 UTC).
carmen: what changed in staging? any regression alerts?
ben: staging had a quant path tweak yesterday, but perf looked fine. I suspect a KV-cache edge under higher seqs.
marie: agree rollback to previous image is safest if we need to abort. Requesting expedited approval to skip extended canary and do staged 25% -> 100% traffic shift.
pm-reeves: @marie can you paste the rollback plan and customer-facing note? we should prep the release note.
marie: rollback plan below, release note draft in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/hotfix-emb-eu
marie: ```
# rollback steps
1) pin service to image sha: sha256:aa11bb22
2) run: ./tools/deploy --service embeddings-eu --image sha256:aa11bb22 --traffic 25
3) monitor error-rate, then shift to 100% if ok
4) if error-rate rises, run: ./tools/rollback --service embeddings-eu
```
marie: deploy window requested 09:30-09:45 UTC, will hold until ops + pm ack.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOYBOT] preflight checks: lint ok, infra health ok, e2e smoke: flaky (1/5) — please confirm proceeding.
ops-lucas: e2e smoke flaky is expected for long-seq test. I'm oncall and will monitor. I vote :thumbsup: for expedited deploy, provided rollback cmd is ready.
ben: +1 from eng. I will run staged rollout.
pc-reeves: :+1: from PM; customer comms ready, I'll send a targeted note if we push.
carmen: adding a small sanity check: watch kv-cache-miss-rate and p99-latency during rollout.
marie: running deploy now (09:31) — will update with traffic shift events.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOYBOT] action triggered by ben: ./tools/deploy --service embeddings-eu --image sha256:cc33dd44 --traffic 25 --tag hotfix-7410
marie: 09:32 -> 25% applied. watching metrics.
ops-lucas: observed error-rate down from 3.1% -> 0.6% at 09:34. KV miss rate normalizing.
marie: shifting to 100% (09:36).
deploy-bot: [DEPLOYBOT] traffic shift: 100% -> embeddings-eu (image sha256:cc33dd44) at 09:36
ben: confirming p95/p99 OK. no customer escalations.
marie: marking as hotfix deployed and adding release note: "embeddings-eu: fixed KV-cache interaction causing 502s on long sequences"
pc-reeves: sending customer comms now.
carmen: recommend postmortem item: add long-sequence smoke to nightly tests.
ops-lucas: closing watch window. all clear at 09:47. Great job team. :tada:
